svg.aria-label: Project 3 of 4: Flowcast (lloydaq/flowcast). Traffic speed forecasting for 207 Los Angeles highway sensors, 15–60 min ahead. Leakage-tested features, LightGBM and a DCRNN graph network compared with bootstrap significance, plus a React dashboard that replays each forecast against what actually happened. Stack: Python, LightGBM, DCRNN, FastAPI, React.
